lines.text: Many learners say: He is thought be very smart.
Better: He is thought to be very smart.
Is thought to plus verb. Don't drop to.
To be! The castle is thought to be 500 years old.

data.wrong: He is thought be very smart.
data.right: He is thought to be very smart.
data.why: Is thought to plus verb. Don't drop to.
